title: Historical Perspective and Further Reading
summary: Work through Historical Perspective and Further Reading.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** in *The Nervous System* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Nervous System, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: The phase-margin arguments that keep high-bandwidth joint feedback loops inside local motor drives predate digital computing. @nyquist1932regeneration established the foundational stability criterion that determines whether a closed-loop feedback amplifier will oscillate, and @bode1945network formalized these dynamics into the gain and phase margins that control engineers budget today. When mechanical and analog controllers transitioned to software, sampled-data control theory formalized how digital sample-and-hold stages, discrete computation steps, and communication transport introduce pure time delays that consume this margin.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Worst-case execution time matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A declared WCET is an analytical upper bound on a task's run time on a given processor, distinct from the unknown true worst case and from any measured maximum.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: The permission path interpolates admitted waypoints into a setpoint for every bus cycle and falls back on its own when waypoints stop arriving.

Sample-and-hold, compute, and bus transport each subtract omega_c*tau of phase at crossover, so fast loops must close inside the drive and the permission tick can supervise them but never sit in them.
A declared WCET is an analytical upper bound on a task's run time on a given processor, distinct from the unknown true worst case and from any measured maximum.

An admitted chunk may drive the actuators only for a lease counted on the permission path's own clock, derived from the plant: longer than the renewal period plus jitter and short enough to fit under the pre-brake ceiling of the stopping budget.
